Looking at this question about the paper "Quantifying local stiffness and forces in soft biological tissues using droplet optical microcavities" (PNAS, 2023), I need to recall the typical error reported for their strain measurement technique.

This paper describes a method using liquid droplet optical microcavities as local mechanical sensors in soft biological tissues. The technique measures strain through shifts in the optical resonance of the droplet cavity. In their validation and characterization of the method, the typical error for the strain measurement was reported to be approximately 5%.
